hypothesis: Instruction count is approximately a fixed overhead plus per-image, per-element, and per-row costs for converting the NumPy batch into PIL images.

pcvs.name: batch_size
pcvs.rationale: Counts per-image PIL construction and list iteration overhead.

pcvs.name: element_count
pcvs.rationale: Tracks multiplication, rounding, uint8 conversion, and pixel serialization work.

pcvs.name: total_rows
pcvs.rationale: Captures per-row copying and RGB decoding overhead.
